WITH
  toDate($__toTime) AS as_of,
  toStartOfMonth(as_of) AS month_start
SELECT sumOrNull(cost) AS usd
FROM (
  SELECT
    toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
    Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
    Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
    Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
    argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS cost
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'billing.cost'
    AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
    AND $__filters
    AND TimeUnix >= toDateTime(month_start)
    AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
  GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
)
LIMIT 1

WITH
  toDate($__toTime) AS as_of,
  toStartOfMonth(as_of) AS month_start,
  dateDiff('day', month_start, as_of) + 1 AS elapsed_days,
  toDayOfMonth(toLastDayOfMonth(as_of)) AS month_days
SELECT sumOrNull(cost) / elapsed_days * month_days AS usd
FROM (
  SELECT
    toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
    Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
    Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
    Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
    argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS cost
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'billing.cost'
    AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
    AND $__filters
    AND TimeUnix >= toDateTime(month_start)
    AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
  GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
)
LIMIT 1

WITH $__toTime AS _as_of
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, argMax(Value, TimeUnix)) AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'billing.fx_rate'
  AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
  AND _as_of IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  toDateTime(day) AS ts,
  provider,
  sum(cost) AS cost
FROM (
  SELECT
    toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
    Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
    Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
    Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
    argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS cost
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'billing.cost'
    AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
    AND $__filters
    AND toDate(TimeUnix) >= toDate($__fromTime)
    AND toDate(TimeUnix) <= toDate($__toTime)
  GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
)
GROUP BY ts, provider
ORDER BY ts, provider
LIMIT 10000

WITH
  toDate($__toTime) AS as_of,
  toStartOfMonth(as_of) AS month_start
SELECT
  provider,
  sum(cost) AS cost
FROM (
  SELECT
    toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
    Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
    Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
    Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
    argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS cost
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'billing.cost'
    AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
    AND $__filters
    AND TimeUnix >= toDateTime(month_start)
    AND toDate(TimeUnix) <= as_of
  GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
)
GROUP BY provider
ORDER BY cost DESC, provider
LIMIT 50

WITH
  toDate($__toTime) AS as_of,
  toStartOfMonth(as_of) AS month_start,
  toStartOfMonth(addMonths(as_of, -1)) AS last_start,
  (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'billing.fx_rate' AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry') AS fx
SELECT
  provider,
  mtd_usd,
  mtd_usd * fx AS mtd_aud,
  last_usd AS last_month_usd,
  last_usd * fx AS last_month_aud,
  if(last_usd = 0, NULL, (mtd_usd - last_usd) / last_usd * 100) AS delta_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    provider,
    sumIf(cost, day >= month_start AND day <= as_of) AS mtd_usd,
    sumIf(cost, day >= last_start AND day < month_start) AS last_usd
  FROM (
    SELECT
      toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
      Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
      Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
      Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
      argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS cost
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'billing.cost'
      AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
      AND $__filters
      AND TimeUnix >= toDateTime(last_start)
      AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
    GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
  )
  GROUP BY provider
)
ORDER BY mtd_usd DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH
  toDate($__fromTime) AS range_start,
  toDate($__toTime) AS range_end,
  (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'billing.fx_rate' AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry') AS fx
SELECT
  cost.provider AS provider,
  cost.sku AS sku,
  cost.scope AS scope,
  cost.source AS source,
  ifNull(usage.usage, 0) AS usage,
  if(ifNull(usage.unit, '') != '', usage.unit, cost.unit) AS unit,
  cost.cost AS cost_usd,
  cost.cost * fx AS cost_aud
FROM (
  SELECT
    provider,
    sku,
    scope,
    argMax(source, day) AS source,
    if(uniqExact(unit) = 1, argMax(unit, day), '') AS unit,
    sum(cost) AS cost
  FROM (
    SELECT
      toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
      Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
      Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
      Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
      argMax(Attributes['billing.source'], toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS source,
      argMax(Attributes['billing.unit'], toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS unit,
      argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS cost
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'billing.cost'
      AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
      AND $__filters
      AND toDate(TimeUnix) >= range_start
      AND toDate(TimeUnix) <= range_end
    GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
  )
  GROUP BY provider, sku, scope
) AS cost
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    provider,
    sku,
    scope,
    sum(usage) AS usage,
    if(uniqExact(unit) = 1, argMax(unit, day), '') AS unit
  FROM (
    SELECT
      toDate(TimeUnix) AS day,
      Attributes['billing.provider'] AS provider,
      Attributes['billing.sku'] AS sku,
      Attributes['billing.scope'] AS scope,
      argMax(Attributes['billing.unit'], toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS unit,
      argMax(Value, toUInt64OrZero(Attributes['billing.observed_at_unix_ms'])) AS usage
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'billing.usage'
      AND ServiceName = 'cost-telemetry'
      AND $__filters
      AND toDate(TimeUnix) >= range_start
      AND toDate(TimeUnix) <= range_end
    GROUP BY day, provider, sku, scope
  )
  GROUP BY provider, sku, scope
) AS usage ON usage.provider = cost.provider AND usage.sku = cost.sku AND usage.scope = cost.scope
ORDER BY cost.cost DESC
LIMIT 50
